body:
## Why

The app is meant to suggest unusual places from Atlas Obscura, but in real trips it never looks. Three sessions in the `road-trip-agent` Phoenix project had 28 stay researcher and leg scout runs and no Atlas Obscura search. None of the 274 candidates they added links to Atlas Obscura, and the workers' traced thinking never mentions it.

| Trip | Phoenix session ID |
|---|---|
| Bar Harbor | `89f4dea6-6cb9-4320-a917-c063620acca9` |
| Florida | `7b417a52-9ed3-46bb-8457-7705ac231aa8` |
| San Francisco to Los Angeles (simulated user) | `6a5a3840-2911-46d0-8579-aae28f06961b` |

The search itself works. A local run on 2026-10-30 searched "Cambria San Simeon Morro Bay unusual places" with `allowed_domains` set to `atlasobscura.com`, and got results. What stops it is when the workers are told to search:

- **The stay researcher skipped its rule.** Its prompt says to run both a general and an Atlas Obscura search when it fills attraction stops for a stay of two or more nights. That applied to three Florida stays: Titusville (later moved to Cocoa Beach), Miami, and Key West. It ran neither search for those stops.
- **The stay researcher's rule leaves out one-night stays.** That covers Portland on the Bar Harbor trip, and every stay on the San Francisco trip.
- **The leg scout searches only for a stop an unusual place fits.** The stops it got had narrow purposes, such as "a classic Maine lighthouse on the coast drive", or were only lunch. The Bar Harbor trip's Day 1 drive had only a lunch stop, so nothing led it to search.
- **The coordinator leaves no stop open for a surprise.** It picks the attractions itself and writes narrow purposes. A user who doesn't ask for odd places never sees one, even where they're close by. Example: a search from Claude Code, not through the app, for "Bangor Maine unusual places", limited to `atlasobscura.com`, listed Stephen King's former house and the Paul Bunyan statue.

## Design

- [Technical spec](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/technical-spec.md), 6.1 (the stay researcher) and 6.2 (the leg scout).
- [Web search design](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/data-sources/web-search.md), sections 2 and 3.
- `src/agent/stay-researcher-prompt.ts` and `src/agent/leg-scout-prompt.ts`, each in its `WEB_SEARCH` text.
- #223, the evaluation of how the leg scout checks its Atlas Obscura finds. It also counts the towns the leg scout searches. This issue is about whether the workers search at all, and whether the user sees what they find.

## Open questions

- How do Atlas Obscura finds reach the user? Proposal: each worker runs one Atlas Obscura search for each town it covers, whatever the stops' purposes, and hands the best finds to the coordinator, which offers them as extras. Fixing the stay researcher's skipped rule alone isn't enough, since it would still leave out one-night stays and drives with no attraction stop.
- Should the coordinator ask whether the user likes offbeat places, and search only if they do? Proposal: no. Offering one or two finds lets the user decide, and a user who wouldn't think to ask still sees them.
- How is it scored? Proposal: code counts the Atlas Obscura searches and the towns they name for each run, from the trace, and checks whether a find reached the coordinator's reply. A judge on Haiku says whether each find it offered fits the user.
- Which cases, and how many runs? Proposal: the Bar Harbor trip and the Florida trip, recorded above, from a turn that sends out workers (`npm run run-turn`, DEVELOPMENT.md section 5), with 5 runs for each case.

## Do

- Write the evaluation, and run it on the instructions as they are now.
- Change the workers' and the coordinator's instructions as the open questions settle, and update the technical spec and the web search design to match. The implementer drafts the wording, and Joe reviews it in the PR.
- Run the evaluation again. Record the results before and after in the PR.

## Done when

- The results before and after the change are recorded for each case.
- The evaluation stays in the set, so later changes rerun it.
- `npm run check` passes.

## Ends in

A PR.

**Settled in:** chat. Propose each answer to Joe in chat first, and write it in once he agrees.
